name: Cudgel
flavor: A length of fen-oak with strong opinions.

name: Dagger
flavor: Everyone in Thornmere owns one. Most admit it.

name: Quarterstaff
flavor: Six feet of ash, no apologies.

name: Shortsword
flavor: Honest steel for dishonest work.

name: Hand Axe
flavor: Splits kindling, doors, and differences of opinion.

name: Fen Spear
flavor: Long enough to ask the marsh a question and stay dry.

name: Broadsword
flavor: Wide as a grave-plank and twice as final.

name: War Hammer
flavor: For arguments armour thinks it has won.

name: Flail
flavor: A threshing tool that changed careers.

name: Longsword
flavor: The town's word for law, in its older dialect.

name: Fine Rapier
flavor: Light, quick, and rude in three languages.

name: Great Axe
flavor: Carried by Korrun gate-guards and very calm people.

name: Fen Cleaver
flavor: Forged for the last wight-war. Still owed one.

name: Oathblade
flavor: It will not cut its bearer, nor forgive them either.

name: Wightbane
flavor: Grave-silver in the steel. The dead feel it coming.

name: Sling
flavor: A strap of leather and a low opinion of distance.

name: Throwing Knives
flavor: A brace of quiet answers.

name: Short Bow
flavor: Fen-yew, strung with waxed flax.

name: Long Bow
flavor: Taller than a Fennick. Reaches further than rumour.

name: Tallowbrand
flavor: A sword quenched in the Tallow King's own vats. It burns without heat.

name: Needle Shard
flavor: A splinter of the spire itself. It wants back in — through something.

name: Stormpike
flavor: A lightning-rod that learned the other half of its trade.

name: Traveller's Robes
flavor: Wool against the fen-damp. Dignity not included.

name: Padded Jack
flavor: Quilted linen, stuffed with horsehair and hope.

name: Leather Armor
flavor: Boiled hard in the tannery, back when the tannery boiled anything.

name: Studded Leather
flavor: Leather with iron punctuation.

name: Chain Mail
flavor: Ten thousand small promises, linked.

name: Scale Mail
flavor: Dressed like a river-pike, hit like one too.

name: Plate Armor
flavor: A keep you can lose your keys to.

name: Mistweave Robe
flavor: Woven from fog on a frame of riddles. Blades disagree about where you are.

name: Fen-Warden's Mail
flavor: Worn by the last captain to hold the east gate. It remembers how.

name: Buckler
flavor: A dinner plate that fights back.

name: Round Shield
flavor: Linden wood, iron boss, somebody's painted goose.

name: Tower Shield
flavor: A door that takes your side.

name: The Wardshield
flavor: A verse of the Founding Song is hammered round the rim. Curses read it and leave.

name: Leather Cap
flavor: Keeps the rain out and most of the thoughts in.

name: Iron Helm
flavor: Rings like a temple bell when fate comes knocking.

name: Crowned Helm
flavor: Some baron's funeral goods, resold with the dents included.

name: Wool Gloves
flavor: Knitted by somebody's grandmother against somebody's winter.

name: Mail Gauntlets
flavor: Handshakes become negotiations.

name: Weighted Wraps
flavor: Lead thread and linen. The Fistwrights call them 'punctuation.'

name: Reed Pipe
flavor: Cut from the fen's edge. The fen has not asked for it back. Yet.

name: Fen Fiddle
flavor: Strung with gut nobody enquires about. Sweet above, sour below.

name: War Drum
flavor: The heartbeat you wish you had.

name: The Cantor's Fork
flavor: A tuning fork of black bone. Struck, it remembers the Founding's true pitch.

name: Torch
flavor: Pitch, rag, and an hour of courage.

name: Greatcandle
flavor: Temple-grade wax. The dark gives it room out of respect.

name: Storm Lamp
flavor: Whale-oil and horn panes. Laughs at draughts.

name: Healing Draught
flavor: Bitter herbs of the Quiet Flame. Works faster if you complain.

name: Strong Draught
flavor: The same herbs, asked nicely twice.

name: Antidote
flavor: Charcoal, milk-thistle, and the prayer that usually goes with them.

name: Calming Salt
flavor: A pinch under the tongue and the knees remember their job.

name: Stone-Salt
flavor: Scraped from a statue that got better.

name: Eyebright Tonic
flavor: For one hundred breaths, nothing lies to you. People hate it.

name: Flask of Tavern Wine
flavor: The Drowned Goose's second-worst vintage. A Skald's best friend.

name: Thunder Flask
flavor: Bottled weather. Shake, throw, repent.

name: Scroll of Returning
flavor: One word, one way home, one use.

name: Phase Chalk
flavor: Draw a door. Knock once. Don't linger.

name: The First Verse
flavor: A sheet of hammered tin, pierced with note-holes. It hums against the skin.

name: The Second Verse
flavor: A knotted cord of grave-silk. Run it through the fingers and the melody climbs.

name: The Third Verse
flavor: A sliver of bell-bronze, still warm. The Song's ending, and its beginning.
